description: MainPhoneActivity.java is an Android activity class that manages runtime permissions and communication with a wearable device via GoogleApiClient. It handles permission requests, messaging, capability detection, and UI updates related to external storage and wearable permissions.

classes.name: MainPhoneActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages permissions and communication with wearable devices, handling user interactions, GoogleApiClient connection, messaging, and capability updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and builds the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onClickWearBodySensors
methods.description: Handles click event to request data from wear device.

methods.name: onClickPhoneStorage
methods.description: Handles click event to display local external storage info or request permission.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks storage permission status and connects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from permission rationale activity.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Sets up capability and message listeners, checks for wear nodes, and sends permission results if needed.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates wear node list when capability changes.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from wear device, handling permission responses and data.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to connected wear nodes with specified DataMap.

methods.name: updateWearButtonOnUiThread
methods.description: Updates UI button icon based on permission status.

methods.name: logToUi
methods.description: Logs messages to UI thread and console.

methods.name: getPhoneStorageInformation
methods.description: Retrieves and formats list of files in external storage.

methods.name: sendWearPermissionResults
methods.description: Sends permission approval or denial result to wear device.
